name: courses
title_zh: 周日提醒一响，本周菜单和 Intermarché 购
tagline_zh: 别再问「这周吃啥」——它把菜单排好，连 Drive 取货篮都按清单填满。你只负责周日点一次确认，周三去提货。
tagline_en: Stop asking “what's for dinner”—it plans the week and loads the Drive basket. You just confirm once on Sunday.
desc_en: Run the weekly meal plan and fill the Intermarché Drive basket. Use when Charlotte says "courses", "meal plan", "what should I eat this week", or when the Sunday reminder fires.
why_zh: 不是菜谱库，是闭环：菜单决定购物清单，清单直接对接 Intermarché Drive 的篮筐。
why_en: Not a recipe box—a closed loop: menu drives the list, list fills the Drive basket directly. No copy-paste, no forgotten leeks.
limit_zh: 只认 Intermarché Drive 一家超市，且需法国门店库存；不含菜谱创作，菜单得你或别的 skill 先给。
limit_en: Only Intermarché Drive (FR stock). No recipe generation—menu must come from you or another skill. Sunday reminder requires your local calendar.
title_en: Sunday chime fills your Intermarché basket from the week's.
